summary: The Cloud Data Warehouse Engineer builds, manages, and optimizes cloud-native data warehouses for analytics and reporting.
responsibilities: Design cloud data warehouses using AWS Redshift, GCP BigQuery, or Azure
Build ETL/ELT pipelines to load cloud data warehouses
Optimize storage, queries, and cost for cloud platforms
Ensure data security, compliance, and governance
Support BI and analytics teams with data models and reports

education: 3–6 years of experience with cloud data warehousing

skills_required.name: Experience with cloud data warehouse platforms
Python or Scala for automation and transformations
Knowledge of cloud storage and architecture best practices
